INVESTOR.subject: BO Account Opened - Cty Brokerage Limited
INVESTOR.emailExtra:
To fund your trading account, please deposit the required amount into our regulator designated CCBA account at Cty Bank PLC, using your unique 13-digit Virtual Account (VA) Number provided below.

Your Account Details
Account Name: Cty Brokerage Limited
Virtual Account Number: {{vaNumber}}

Deposit Instructions:
1. Transfer the required funds to the above Virtual Account Number through the applicable Cty Bank deposit channel.
2. Please ensure that you use your assigned 13-digit Virtual Account Number when making the deposit so that the funds can be identified and mapped to your trading account correctly.
3. Once Cty Bank confirms the deposit details, we will process the transaction through our internal verification and Finance approval procedures.
4. After successful approval, the deposited amount will be credited to your client Ledger and reflected in your Portfolio and Cty Infinity.
5. You will receive a confirmation through your enabled notification channels once the deposit has been approved and the Ledger and Portfolio have been updated.

Important: Please use only the Virtual Account Number assigned to you. Do not use another client's Virtual Account Number when depositing funds.

For any assistance regarding your deposit, please contact your Relationship Manager.

Best regards,
Cty Brokerage Limited
Client Services Team
Contact: 09678111111
Email: support@ctybrokerageltd.com
